verdict.rationale: Productboard's official MCP server lets a developer's coding agent read product specs straight from Productboard and start building from them, and native integrations push development-ready, validated features into GitHub and other delivery tools. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of gating spec pulls on an 'approved' status, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec-to-implementation flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull an approved product specification into the delivery workflow to start implementation

citations.quote: The Productboard MCP server lets your coding agent read product specs straight from Productboard — and write back to them.
Access your latest product specifications from coding agents and AI prototyping tools to initiate the product delivery process.
Pull a spec, talk through the plan with your agent, and build. No setup beyond the connection.
Push features ready for development into GitHub as issues.
only sending fully-validated features into delivery
